from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg)
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for color, n in counts.items():
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if n < 8:
            continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
        if area >= 8 and n / area >= 0.65:
            for r in range(r0,r1+1):
                for c in range(c0,c1+1): out[r][c]=color
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg)
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    # Discard sparse noise and fill the bounding rectangle of each dense shape.
    for color, n in counts.items():
        if n < 10:
            continue
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
        r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        area = (r1 - r0 + 1) * (c1 - c0 + 1)
        if area >= 8 and n / area >= 0.65:
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
                for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
